summary: Completed frontend testing of redesigned Proton (Diagnostics) and Pharmacy (Orange) pages with pastel theme. Both pages load correctly with new designs. All core functionality works: test selection, cart management, OTP verification, back navigation. Found 1 bug: Pharmacy search autocomplete not working due to missing backend endpoint.

minor.issue: Endpoint does not exist - returns 404. Frontend Pharmacy.js line 196 calls this endpoint for autocomplete but it's not implemented in server.py

integration_issues.issue: Autocomplete dropdown doesn't show suggestions because /api/pharmacy/search endpoint returns 404

action_items: Add /api/pharmacy/search endpoint to backend server.py to enable medicine autocomplete functionality
critical_code_review_comments: Proton.js: Well-structured with proper data-testid attributes, pastel teal theme (#5FA8D3) correctly implemented
Pharmacy.js: Well-structured with proper data-testid attributes, pastel orange theme (#F97316) correctly implemented
Both pages have proper step progress indicators (Select Tests/Cart → Verify → Book/Pay)
OTP system is MOCKED - displays demo OTP on screen for testing
All 4266 medicines inventory preserved and accessible via inventory list
All diagnostic tests (blood, urine, sputum, imaging) preserved
Booking flow same as before - just modernized UI
